name: process_score_template
label: Rating Template -- Workflow Association Table
description: Score template - workflow association table is used for filtering enabled states of workflows and for querying related data in reporting scenarios.

fields.name: score_template_id
fields.description: Template ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: process_uuid
fields.description: Workflow UUID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Do you want to enable ratings (0: no, 1: yes)?

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the score_template_id, process_uuid fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.
